title: Finite local cohomology of the restricted constant coefficient complex
statement: Let a:X→T be any scheme morphism and f:A→B a map of finite commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Regard the regular constant B_T-module as an A_T-module and place it in degree zero, giving L [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars, lem-sp-restricted-scalar-tensor-cohomology-comparison]. For every integer j the actual constant-coefficient pullback a_A^* H^j(QL) is locally constant and every geometric module stalk is finite [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk].

proof.text: The constant A-module B maps to the constant-scalar restriction of Res(B_T) by the B-ring sheafification unit. Naturality of that unit in A→B proves linearity. The unit is locally bijective on underlying sets, so its sheafified linear map is an isomorphism.

The existing constant-scalar pullback encoding and uniqueness of the constant/pullback left adjoints identify the pulled-back restricted regular module with the constant A-module B. The identity cover and the finite value B give finite local models. The intrinsic/fixed constructibility comparison supplies local constancy and finite geometric stalks.

The single-complex homology is the restricted regular module in degree zero and zero otherwise. Transport the preceding result in degree zero. Exact constant-coefficient inverse image takes the other zero objects to zero; the zero model and zero stalk are finite.

lean.statement:
theorem restrictedScalarCoefficient_finiteLocalConstancy
    {T X : Scheme.{u}} (a : X ⟶ T)
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B] (f : A →+* B)
    (j : ℤ) :
    IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheaf X A
      (proEtaleConstantModulePullback a A
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (proEtaleRingModules T (proEtaleConstantRing T A)) j).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (restrictedScalarCoefficientComplex T f)))) ∧
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X),
      Finite (proEtaleGeometricModuleStalk x (proEtaleConstantRing X A)
        (proEtaleConstantModulePullback a A
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (proEtaleRingModules T (proEtaleConstantRing T A)) j).obj
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (restrictedScalarCoefficientComplex T f)))))
